newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong to push infrastructure firms in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong to push infrastructure firms in 1997.

text.p: China' southern Guangdong will mainly recommend firms in infrastructure industries to offer and list A or B shares in 1997, in line with state industrial policy, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Wednesday.

Guangdong will support companies in agriculture, energy, transport, telecommunications, raw materials production and high-tech industry, the newspaper quoted Liu Xingqiang, head of the Guangdong Securities Regulatory Commission, as saying.
It has ruled out recommending firms in the processing, commercial, financial and real estate sectors, Liu said.
Liu added that listing candidates must have solid record of profits and good market outlook.
Share offers and listing applications are subject to the final approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the country's top securities watchdog, Liu added.
